custom_logic_notes: The core trading logic (entry/exit signal generation) is entirely encapsulated in CMS_ES_Stoch class from ACMS_ES_Stoch.mqh. The EA uses MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework with a weighted signal filter pattern. Signal_ThresholdOpen=40 and Signal_ThresholdClose=20 define the composite signal thresholds. The CMS_ES_Stoch filter combines Stochastic oscillator values with an MA smoothing layer (period=4) to generate buy/sell signals. Weight=1.0 means this single filter fully determines the signal. The actual crossover/comparison logic within CMS_ES_Stoch::LongCondition() and ShortCondition() is not visible in this file and requires reading the .mqh source. No SL/TP is set at the expert level - exits are purely signal-driven. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA only evaluates on new bar formation.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACMS_ES_Stoch.mqh to extract the actual LongCondition()/ShortCondition() logic. The CExpert framework's signal weighting and threshold mechanism needs to be replicated. Stochastic indicator can be replicated with ta-lib or pandas-ta. The MA(period=4) applied to stochastic output is a custom smoothing step within the signal class. No SL/TP simplifies conversion - exits are signal-based only. The new-bar guard (Expert_EveryTick=false) means daily/bar-based resampling is sufficient.
